mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO benefit ( plcy_no, plcy_nm, category_code, sprvsn_inst_cd_nm, target_desc, plcy_sprt_cn, support_amount, plcy_aply_mthd_cn, sbmsn_dcmnt_cn, apply_start_date, apply_end_date, aply_ymd, aply_prd_se_cd, aply_url_addr, sprt_trgt_min_age, sprt_trgt_max_age, earn_cnd_se_cd, earn_min_amt, earn_max_amt, earn_etc_cn, mrg_stts_cd, conflict_group_code, inq_cnt, is_active, frst_reg_dt, last_mdfcn_dt, plcy_expln_cn )
VALUES ( #{plcyNo}, #{plcyNm}, #{categoryCode}, #{sprvsnInstCdNm}, #{targetDesc}, #{plcySprtCn}, #{supportAmount}, #{plcyAplyMthdCn}, #{sbmsnDcmntCn}, #{applyStartDate}, #{applyEndDate}, #{aplyYmd}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{aplyPrdSeCd}), ''), #{aplyUrlAddr}, #{sprtTrgtMinAge}, #{sprtTrgtMaxAge}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{earnCndSeCd}), ''), #{earnMinAmt}, #{earnMaxAmt}, #{earnEtcCn}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{mrgSttsCd}), ''), #{conflictGroupCode}, IFNULL(#{inqCnt}, 0), IFNULL(#{isActive}, 'Y'), IFNULL(#{frstRegDt}, NOW()), NOW(), #{plcyExplnCn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE plcy_nm = VALUES(plcy_nm), category_code = VALUES(category_code), sprvsn_inst_cd_nm = VALUES(sprvsn_inst_cd_nm), target_desc = VALUES(target_desc), plcy_sprt_cn = VALUES(plcy_sprt_cn), support_amount = VALUES(support_amount), plcy_aply_mthd_cn = VALUES(plcy_aply_mthd_cn), sbmsn_dcmnt_cn = VALUES(sbmsn_dcmnt_cn), apply_start_date = VALUES(apply_start_date), apply_end_date = VALUES(apply_end_date), aply_ymd = VALUES(aply_ymd), aply_prd_se_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(aply_prd_se_cd)), ''), aply_url_addr = VALUES(aply_url_addr), sprt_trgt_min_age = VALUES(sprt_trgt_min_age), sprt_trgt_max_age = VALUES(sprt_trgt_max_age), earn_cnd_se_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(earn_cnd_se_cd)), ''), earn_min_amt = VALUES(earn_min_amt), earn_max_amt = VALUES(earn_max_amt), earn_etc_cn = VALUES(earn_etc_cn), mrg_stts_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(mrg_stts_cd)), ''), inq_cnt = VALUES(inq_cnt), is_active = VALUES(is_active), last_mdfcn_dt = NOW(), plcy_expln_cn = VALUES(plcy_expln_cn)
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit SET inq_cnt = #{inqCnt}, is_active = #{isActive}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE plcy_no = #{plcyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT category_code AS categoryCode, category_name AS categoryName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM benefit_category ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT r.zip_cd AS zipCd, r.region_name AS regionName, r.parent_region_code AS parentRegionCode,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM region child WHERE child.parent_region_code = r.zip_cd ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasChildren
FROM region r
WHERE r.parent_region_code IS NULL
WHERE r.parent_region_code = #{parentRegionCode}
ORDER BY r.zip_cd ASC

SELECT code AS plcyMajorCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0011' AND api_field = 'plcyMajorCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0011009' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS schoolCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0049' AND api_field = 'schoolCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0049010' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS jobCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0013' AND api_field = 'jobCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0013010' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS mrgSttsCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0055' AND api_field = 'mrgSttsCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0055003' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

WITH RECURSIVE region_scope AS ( SELECT r.zip_cd, r.parent_region_code FROM region r WHERE r.zip_cd = #{zipCd}
UNION ALL
SELECT child.zip_cd, child.parent_region_code FROM region child INNER JOIN region_scope parent ON child.parent_region_code = parent.zip_cd )
SELECT b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_no AS plcyNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, b.category_code AS categoryCode, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, b.apply_start_date AS applyStartDate, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, b.aply_prd_se_cd AS aplyPrdSeCd, b.is_active AS isActive,
CASE WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 'ALWAYS'
WHEN b.apply_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'CLOSED'
ELSE 'OPEN' END AS benefitStatus
FROM benefit b JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.category_code = bc.category_code
WHERE 1 = 1
AND b.category_code = #{categoryCode}
AND ( b.plcy_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.plcy_expln_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.plcy_sprt_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_region br WHERE br.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND br.zip_cd IN ( SELECT zip_cd FROM region_scope ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_major bm WHERE bm.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bm.plcy_major_cd = #{plcyMajorCd} OR bm.plcy_major_cd = '0011009' ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_school bs WHERE bs.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bs.school_cd = #{schoolCd} OR bs.school_cd = '0049010' ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_job bj WHERE bj.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bj.job_cd = #{jobCd} OR bj.job_cd = '0013010' ) )
AND ( b.mrg_stts_cd = #{mrgSttsCd} OR b.mrg_stts_cd = '0055003' )
AND ( ( b.sprt_trgt_min_age IS NULL OR b.sprt_trgt_min_age = 0 OR b.sprt_trgt_min_age <= #{age} ) AND ( b.sprt_trgt_max_age IS NULL OR b.sprt_trgt_max_age = 0 OR b.sprt_trgt_max_age >= #{age} ) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() THEN 0
WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 1
ELSE 2 END ASC,
CASE WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() THEN b.apply_end_date END ASC,
b.benefit_no DESC
SELECT keyword_code AS keywordCode, keyword_name AS keywordName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM recommend_keyword WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY display_order ASC, keyword_code ASC
